results.title: Mineshaft: The Cruising Murders
results.overview: “Mineshaft: The Cruising Murders" peels back the layers of controversy surrounding the making of the 1980 thriller, "Cruising." Directed by William Friedkin, the film triggered fierce protests from the LGBTQ+ community for its portrayal of a serial killer targeting gay men in New York's leather bars. Friedkin drew inspiration from the brutal murder of Variety reporter Addison Verrill, blurring the boundaries between cinematic fiction and real-life tragedy.

results.title: Alien Storm
results.overview: A father, businessman and secret doomsday prepper escorts people to the safety of his bunker – actually an underground house – when a massive and potentially deadly fog descends and cuts the power at his home.

results.title: Burgundy
results.overview: The story of Burgundy’s most extraordinary characters and a celebration of the pleasure that defines their lives.

results.title: A Mighty Adventure
results.overview: Three little insects are transported to a concrete city. A series of extraordinary micro-adventures forces them to explore themselves and helps to build their self-esteem, so they can finally get back home. They become much stronger and happier, are able to choose their own future.

results.title: Reflected
results.overview: A man wakes up and slowly discovers he is trapped in a mirror world.

results.title: Mao vs Nixon: Game Theory
results.overview: An overview of the lives of Richard Nixon and Chairman Mao, focusing on the geopolitical forces that led to their meeting in 1972 and the resulting effects on the world economy.

results.title: Andhkar
results.overview: Andhkar is a suspense thriller about the murder of a famous painter's wife in her bungalow. Set over one night from 6 p.m. to 6 a.m., it is a classic murder mystery where nothing is as it seems.

results.title: Deacon Blues
results.overview: On the morning of his best friend’s wedding, Edwin goes on a strange journey deciding whether to speak his mind or forever hold his peace.

results.title: Self Custody
results.overview: When a struggling father discovers he unknowingly received a Bitcoin bonus back in 2014--now worth millions--his desperate attempt to reclaim the lost fortune sends him spiraling into a high-stakes world of encrypted wallets, forgotten passwords, and dark web danger. With time running out and his family on the line, he must outsmart hackers, trace digital breadcrumbs, and confront secrets buried in his past.

results.title: Lover, Not a Fighter
results.overview: Andrej has a secret plan – to see no one, meet no one, only talk to his grandma and not climb high trees while being drunk. Then he unexpectedly encounters Miša, at whom he previously tried to smile 17 times while being drunk at parties. He never remembered the outcome as he was always too drunk, but not today. Today he is sober. Andrej and Miša start to talk and over the glass of Fanta find an interest in each other. The fight for their young and tender love begins.

results.title: Warren County
results.overview: An anthology follows a serial killing spree that turns the small town of Warren County into a chilling backdrop for murder.

results.title: 48 Hours in Purgatory
results.overview: Controversial New York filmmaker Brody Hawkins and his team launch a voyeuristic project aimed at using isolation and to push film subjects to their limit and face their inner demons, on camera. When tragedy strikes and the team begins to fray, examiners become the tested and their own ghosts begin to surface.

results.title: Bowels of Hell
results.overview: Malu is organising a gender-reveal party for a pregnant influencer – while dealing with her own grief, her persistent constipation problems and her adolescent transgender child (who disapproves of her job commission). At the condominium where Malu lives, some strange phenomena are unleashed in the home’s most private zone: the bathroom.

results.title: Dark
results.overview: A police investigation frames the story of an atheist office worker whose life descends into terror, frustration and paranoia after relocating to a home with a troubled past. He is forced to question his distorted sense of reality and his views on the paranormal as hidden truths resurface.

results.title: Nosotros
results.overview: Romero, a 23-year-old Indigenous man who used to drive a three-wheeled mototaxi (TucTuc) in his rural town, flees local gang extortion and migrates to Guatemala City. He finds a job as a security guard at a commercial center, where he falls in love with a trans woman who runs a local business. Together, they build an emotional sanctuary, but their bond is quickly threatened by the deep-seated prejudice and hostility of his coworkers.

results.title: Black Annis
results.overview: Following a personal tragedy, Ann becomes aware of an eerie presence stalking her every move, as frightening changes begin to occur.
